name: 翠顶夫人
evolution: 乖乖鹄 → 蓝珠天鹅 Lv.20 → 翠顶夫人 Lv.40
description: 柔弱温顺，羽毛软而蓬松。过于专注梳理羽毛可能会迷路，意识到迷路的时候通常已经游到了完全不认识的环境里。不过总能保持优雅淡定，似乎永远不会慌张惊恐。这或许是夫人为自己制定的礼仪规范。
descriptionEn: Gentle and docile, with soft and fluffy feathers. Being too focused on grooming feathers may lead to getting lost; by the time it realizes, it has usually swum to a completely unfamiliar environment. Yet it always remains elegant and calm, seemingly never panicking. This is perhaps the etiquette the lady sets for herself.
